answers.reason: The faculty administrative officer only takes part where their own faculty matters are decided.
The budget planning round is a central university body, not the faculty place where the officer's matters are decided.
Appointment committees deal with professorships, which is not the administrative officer's specific body.
The faculty council handles the affairs of the faculty where the administrative officer works.
Study commissions prepare degree programme changes, which is outside the administrative officer's specific decision body.
Examination boards decide on student examination matters, not the administrative officer's designated body.
Internal research funding deals with research grants, not the administrative officer's duties.
Module revision working groups rewrite module descriptions, which is not the administrative officer's body.
Laboratory equipment procurement is outside the administrative officer's specific kind of question.
Orientation week planning is handled separately from the administrative officer's designated body.
